learning_outcomes.text: Explains the fundamental concepts and definitions of thermodynamics.
Distinguishes between system, control volume, and property concepts.
Interprets phase behaviors and diagrams of pure substances.
Uses thermodynamic property tables and diagrams.
Analyzes types of energy and energy transformations.
Applies energy equations for closed systems.
Establishes mass and energy balance for open systems.
Applies thermodynamic principles to engineering problems.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to Thermodynamics, basic definitions and concepts
System, control volume, properties and equilibrium
Concept of phase and pure substance, phase diagrams
Property tables and diagrams of pure substances
Types of energy and energy transformations
First Law of Thermodynamics (closed systems – basic approach)
Applications of energy analysis for closed systems
Special cases and problem-solving in closed systems
Introduction to open systems and mass balance
bibliography: Thermodynamics: An Engineering Approach – Yunus A. Çengel and Michael A. Boles
